bundle.shortDescription: Join the CE compute mesh: one node, made legible.
bundle.longDescription: CE Desktop is the flagship native app for ce-net. Join the mesh in one click (it installs and supervises the CE node for you), watch the network live, run apps from the ce-appmgr store, manage capabilities, and see what you earn — the app keeps your node earning in the tray.
